basic_info.description: This is it! Welcome to the Mission's most charming and dynamic micro-neighborhood. Leafy streets and low-scale urban life where San Francisco is centered. Top-floor Victorian flat, lovingly updated but retaining period details-super-tall ceilings, thick bannister, wainscoting, corbels. Open plan living area includes updated eat-in kitchen with marble counters/backsplash and living room anchored by decorative marble fireplace. Beyond is a bright broad sunroom - perfect as an office, den, craft room with direct access to south-facing shared yard. Two commodious front bedrooms could be made into an expansive suite via connecting door. Third back bedroom with walk-in closet. Elegant large bath with clawfoot soaking tub rescued from the old Clift Hotel. Dual-pane windows front & back; newly-refinished hardwood floors. Exclusive use attic for storage/potential future development. Shared laundry and rotational 1-car parking. Special location on 20th slow street. Grab a bite at Flour & Water, Mijote, Penny Roma or San Ho Won. Breakfast at Tartine inside Heath Manufactory. Coffee steps away. Libations at Trick Dog, True Laurel or Lost Resort. This is where San Francisco's creative class meets to print a book, make music or expand AI's limits. Make your home here & take off!
